description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Genuine Suzuki OEM Lens Set.
This set is specifically tailored for Samurai’s that have a custom rear bumper and do not need the Rear Side Marker Lens.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Turn Signal Lens (LH)
Qty 1 – Front Turn Signal Lens (RH)
Qty 1 – Front Sidemarker Lens (LH)
Qty 1 – Front Sidemarker Lens (RH)
Qty 1 – Rear Brake/Reverse/Turn Lens (LH)
Qty 1 – Rear Brake/Reverse/Turn Lens (RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
